country.match: Match each battle to the country where it was fought.

war.match: Match each battle to the war it belonged to.

rows.label: Battle of Stalingrad
rows.description: 1942 major battle of World War II
rows.hook: ended with a whole German army trapped and captured in a ruined city on the Volga

rows.label: Battle of Midway
rows.description: 1942 World War II naval battle
rows.hook: turned the tide when American dive bombers sank four Japanese aircraft carriers

rows.label: Battle of Thermopylae
rows.description: battle of 480 BCE during Persian invasion of Greece
rows.hook: saw 300 Spartans and their allies hold a narrow coastal pass against a vast invading army

rows.label: Battle of the Little Bighorn
rows.description: June 1876 battle of the Great Sioux War
rows.hook: ended with Custer's cavalry wiped out by Lakota and Cheyenne warriors

rows.label: Battle of Gettysburg
rows.description: 1863 battle of the American Civil War
rows.hook: was the bloodiest of its conflict, ended with Pickett's Charge failing, and inspired a famous Lincoln speech

rows.label: Battle of the Alamo
rows.description: 1836 major battle of the Texas Revolution
rows.hook: saw defenders including Davy Crockett and Jim Bowie fall at an old mission

rows.label: Battle of the Somme
rows.description: battle of the Western Front, World War I
rows.hook: cost the British army its bloodiest first day ever and saw tanks used for the first time

rows.label: Battle of Berlin
rows.description: 1945 last major offensive of the European theatre of World War Il
rows.hook: ended when Soviet troops reached Hitler's bunker and the fighting in Europe neared its end

rows.label: Battle of the Teutoburg Forest
rows.description: battle between a coalition of Germanic peoples and an Imperial Roman army, 9 BCE
rows.hook: saw three Roman legions ambushed and destroyed in dense woodland

rows.label: Battle of Britain
rows.description: air battle waged between German and British air forces in 1940
rows.hook: saw the RAF's Spitfires and Hurricanes fend off the Luftwaffe in the skies

rows.label: Siege of Yorktown
rows.description: siege, part of American Revolutionary War
rows.hook: ended with Cornwallis surrendering to Washington and effectively sealed independence

rows.label: Battle of Borodino
rows.description: 1812 battle during the French invasion of Russia
rows.hook: was the bloodiest single day of Napoleon's march toward Moscow

rows.label: Battle of Marathon
rows.description: 490 BCE battle in the Greco-Persian wars
rows.hook: inspired the legend of a runner dashing to Athens with news of victory, and a modern long-distance race

rows.label: Battle of Dien Bien Phu
rows.description: The decisive battle of the First Indochina War
rows.hook: ended colonial rule in Southeast Asia after a siege in a remote mountain valley

rows.label: Battle of Sedan
rows.description: 1870 battle during the Franco-Prussian War
rows.hook: ended with the French emperor Napoleon III taken prisoner

rows.label: Battle of Monte Cassino
rows.description: 1944 assaults by the Allies against the Winter Line in Italy held by Axis forces during the Italian Campaign of World War II
rows.hook: saw an ancient hilltop abbey founded by St. Benedict bombed by the Allies

rows.label: First Battle of the Marne
rows.description: 1914 First World War battle
rows.hook: saved Paris from capture when taxis ferried in reinforcements

rows.label: Second Battle of El Alamein
rows.description: 1942 major turning point in the Western Desert Campaign of the Second World War
rows.hook: was Montgomery's victory over Rommel that turned the tide in North Africa

rows.label: Battle of Manzikert
rows.description: 1071 battle between the Byzantine Empire and Seljuk Turks
rows.hook: left an Eastern Roman emperor captured and opened Anatolia to nomadic newcomers

rows.label: Battle of Salamis
rows.description: 480 BCE naval battle fought between an alliance of Greek city-states and the Persian Empire
rows.hook: saw Themistocles lure a huge fleet into narrow straits and sink it

rows.label: Battle of Tours
rows.description: battle fought in 732 by Merovingian Franks against the Umayyad Caliphate
rows.hook: stopped an Islamic army's push north under Charles Martel, the Hammer

rows.label: Battle of Crécy
rows.description: 1346 battle of the Hundred Years' War
rows.hook: showed longbowmen cutting down charging armoured knights

rows.label: Battle of Crete
rows.war: World War II in the Balkans
rows.description: 1941 battle during WWII on the Greek island of Crete
rows.hook: saw German paratroopers drop onto an island in the first large airborne invasion

rows.label: Battle of Poitiers
rows.description: 1356 battle of the Hundred Years' War
rows.hook: saw a king captured by England's Black Prince

rows.label: Battle of Alesia
rows.description: decisive Roman victory in which Rome secures the conquest of Gaul
rows.hook: trapped Vercingetorix in a fortress town inside Caesar's double siege lines

rows.label: Dieppe Raid
rows.description: 1942 landing operation in World War II
rows.hook: cost many Canadian troops their lives in a failed seaside assault that taught lessons for D-Day

rows.label: Iraqi invasion of Kuwait
rows.description: 1990 major conflict between the Ba'athist Iraq and the state of Kuwait
rows.hook: was Saddam Hussein's lightning takeover of a small oil-rich neighbour, leading to Desert Storm

rows.label: Battle of Fort Sumter
rows.description: bombardment of Fort Sumter, immediate cause and first battle of the American Civil War
rows.hook: began with cannon fire on a harbour fortress in Charleston

rows.label: Battle of the Nile
rows.war: French invasion of Egypt and Syria
rows.description: 1798 naval battle during the French invasion of Egypt
rows.hook: saw Admiral Nelson wipe out Napoleon's fleet at anchor in a bay

rows.label: Battle of Carrhae
rows.description: ancient battle between Roman Republic and Parthian Empire in 53 BCE near modern Harran, Turkey
rows.hook: saw a wealthy Roman general killed by horse archers in the desert

rows.label: Battle of Tannenberg
rows.description: 1914 battle between Russia and Germany
rows.hook: saw a German army encircle and crush an invading army, making Hindenburg famous

rows.label: Battle of Pharsalus
rows.description: 48 BCE decisive battle of Caesar's Civil War
rows.hook: saw Pompey defeated and the Republic's last hopes end

rows.label: Battle of Issus
rows.description: second great battle of Alexander's conquest of Asia
rows.hook: saw a young Macedonian king rout Darius III and send him fleeing

rows.label: Battle of Kiev
rows.description: 1941 battle resulting in a large encirclement of Soviet troops in the vicinity of Kiev during World War II
rows.hook: was the largest encirclement in history, capturing hundreds of thousands of Soviet soldiers
